README.md.ctx: Project README for a qwen-code extension maintaining a file dependency graph with one-sentence LLM notes and a scout subagent for finding relevant files.

agents/sourcemap-scout.md.ctx: Defines the sourcemap-scout subagent that queries the deepgraph index to return files relevant to a task.

deepgraph/README.md.ctx: Documents the deepgraph CLI that builds a codebase dependency graph with per-file notes and fuzzy/semantic search.

hooks/prompts/annotate.md.ctx: Prompt instructing an LLM to write a one-sentence context note for each file in a batch.

hooks/prompts/scout-hint.md.ctx: Hint prompting the model to delegate relevant-file lookup to the sourcemap-scout subagent.
